doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.lead: Profiles, fees, weekly schedules and days off. Online booking uses these schedules.
doctors.empty_text: Add your first doctor with their working hours to start booking appointments.
doctors.bilingual_hint: Arabic is required; English is shown when the page is in English.
doctors.specialty_key_help: Sets the specialty records shown for this doctor (such as the eye exam or the audiogram).
doctors.room_hint: Shown on the waiting-room screen next to the patient name (e.g. 3 or 2B).
doctors.slot_help: Also the step between bookable start times.
doctors.show_fee: Show the fee on the clinic page
doctors.schedule_help: Up to two shifts per day and one break. Untick a day to mark it off.
doctors.delete_confirm: Deleting a doctor removes their schedule. Past invoices keep the doctor's name. Type the doctor's name to confirm.
doctors.hours_clinic_help: The doctor's hours change by themselves when the clinic's hours change.
doctors.hours_clinic_none: The clinic's hours are not set yet, so the default week is used (Sat–Thu 9:00–17:00).
doctors.social_sub: Shown as icons on the doctor's card and page on the website. Leave a field empty to hide it.
doctors.profile_sub: Shown on the doctor's page of the website. Education goes in the education fields above.

services.title: Services & prices
services.lead: What patients can book. A service without a doctor is offered by every doctor.
services.empty_text: Add services with their price and duration; bookings use the duration to find free slots.
services.show_price: Show the price on the clinic page
services.show_on_site: Shown on the clinic website and booking page
services.price_help: Leave empty when the price depends on the case.
services.billing_note: The price here is shown on the website and suggested only: the bill comes from the services the doctor enters in the visit.
services.duration_help: Leave empty for a service with no fixed time: the appointment takes the doctor's usual length.
services.code_help: The service code used by insurers or your own system (optional).
